* service local added to runlevel default
 * service lvm added to runlevel default
#!/bin/sh
# Reattach loop devices backing vgdata, activate LVM, mount /srv/data
for img in /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk1.img /var/lib/lvm-disks/disk2.img; do
    if ! losetup -j "$img" | grep -q .; then
        losetup -f "$img"
    fi
done
vgchange -ay vgdata
mountpoint -q /srv/data || mount /dev/vgdata/lvdata /srv/data
